description: This file sets up and runs an Express server, initializing it with environment-configured host and port, and handles graceful shutdown upon receiving a SIGTERM signal. It also exports the server instance for external use.

methods.name: app.listen
methods.description: Starts the Express application listening on the specified host and port.

methods.name: server.close
methods.description: Closes the HTTP server, stopping it from accepting new connections.

methods.name: console.log
methods.description: Outputs informational messages to the console.

methods.name: process.on
methods.description: Sets up an event listener for the 'SIGTERM' signal to handle graceful shutdown.

methods.name: process.exit
methods.description: Exits the Node.js process with the specified code.
